Dockerfile Generator

Pick a base image, workdir, RUN steps, ports, and CMD to get a clean, working Dockerfile.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose a base image and working directory.
  2. Add COPY, RUN, ENV, and EXPOSE entries.
  3. Click Generate — copy or download the Dockerfile.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which Dockerfile instructions are generated?

Base image, WORKDIR, COPY, ENV, RUN steps, EXPOSE ports, and CMD in exec form.

How do multiple RUN commands work?

Each line of the RUN box becomes its own RUN instruction, in order.

What form is CMD in?

CMD is emitted in exec (JSON array) form; separate arguments with spaces or commas.

Can I download the file?

Yes — copy it or download it as Dockerfile.
